summary: Frontend testing completed for profile photo display and role badges. All features working correctly: (1) Profile photo displays in header and ProfileCard when user has photo_url, (2) OWNER badge with crown icon shows correctly for owner users, (3) 'Propietario' role displays in header, (4) Profile page allows editing name/username/phone with save functionality, (5) Security tab for password change works, (6) handleUserUpdate properly persists changes to localStorage.
passed_tests: Login with admin_demo/test123 credentials works
Dashboard loads correctly after login
Header avatar displays user's Cloudinary photo_url
Header shows user name 'Colegio Demo Settings'
Header shows role 'Propietario' for owner user
ProfileCard displays user's photo correctly
ProfileCard shows 'OWNER' badge with crown icon
ProfileCard badge has amber colors (bg-amber-100 text-amber-700)
ProfileCard shows email and @username
Profile page (/perfil) loads correctly
Profile page shows 3 role badges: Super Admin, Propietario, Director
Profile page photo upload button present (camera icon)
Profile form fields: Name, Last Name, Username, Phone, Email (disabled)
Username field shows green checkmark for current username
Profile save button works - shows success message 'Perfil actualizado correctamente'
Profile changes persist to localStorage via handleUserUpdate
Security tab shows password change form
Security tab has 3 password fields: Current, New, Confirm
Owner protection message displays for owner users
Users page shows categories: Directores, Administradores, Profesores, Estudiantes, Padres, Pendientes
Profesores list shows 5 teachers with photos
DefaultAvatar component properly implemented with initials fallback
Image onError handlers properly hide broken images and show default avatar
critical_code_review_comments: Code quality is good - DefaultAvatar component properly extracts initials from name
Image error handling is properly implemented with onError callbacks
Role display logic correctly prioritizes is_owner > is_super_admin > role
localStorage persistence via handleUserUpdate works correctly
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing admin_demo user
context_for_next_testing_agent: Profile system fully functional. Current admin_demo user has photo_url set (Cloudinary image). DefaultAvatar component shows initials when no photo. Role badges: OWNER (amber with crown), SUPER ADMIN (purple with shield), DIRECTOR (indigo), etc. Profile page at /school/:subdomain/perfil allows editing name, last_name, username, phone. Email is read-only. Password change in Security tab. Owner users see 'Cuenta Protegida' message.

header_avatar.error_handling: onError hides broken image, shows default avatar

header_role_display.other_roles: Shows Spanish translation (Director, Administrador, Profesor, etc.)

profile_card.avatar: Shows photo or default avatar with initials
profile_card.role_badge: OWNER with crown icon, amber colors

profile_page.save: Works, shows success message, updates localStorage

note: Test request mentioned user should have photo_url=null, but actual user has Cloudinary photo. DefaultAvatar code is correctly implemented and will show initials when photo_url is null or image fails to load.
